verses.translation: And Ezekias began to reign at the age of twenty-five years, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Abia, daughter of Zacharias.

translations.ron: Iezechia a fost făcut rege când era de douăzeci şi cinci de ani şi a domnit douăzeci şi nouă de ani în Ierusalim. Pe mama lui o chema Abia şi era fiica lui Zaharia.
translations.grk: Καὶ Ἐζεκίας ἐβασίλευσεν ὢν εἴκοσι καὶ πέντε ἐτῶν, καὶ εἴκοσι ἐννέα ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ἱερουσαλὴμ, καὶ ὄνομα τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ Ἀβιὰ, θυγάτηρ Ζαχαρίου.

verses.translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father David had done.

translations.ron: Acesta a făcut lucruri plăcute înaintea ochilor Domnului, după cum făcuse şi David, strămoşul lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησε τὸ εὐθὲς ἐνώπιον Κυρίου κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησε Δαυὶδ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: And it came to pass, when he was established over his kingdom, in the first month, he opened the doors of the house of the Lord, and repaired them.

translations.ron: În anul întâi al domniei sale, în luna întâi, a descuiat el uşile templului Domnului şi le-a înnoit.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἔστη ἐπὶ τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ, ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ πρώτῳ ἀνέῳξε τὰς θύρας οἴκου Κυρίου καὶ ἐπεσκεύασεν αὐτάς.

verses.translation: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and put them on the east side,

translations.ron: Apoi a poruncit să vină preoţii şi leviţii; pe aceştia i-a adunat în locul deschis dinspre răsărit,
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰσήγαγε τοὺς ἱερεῖς καὶ τοὺς Λευίτας, καὶ κατέστησεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸ κλίτος τὸ πρὸς ἀνατολὰς,

verses.translation: and said to them, Hear, ye Levites: now sanctify yourselves, and sanctify the house of the Lord God of your fathers, and cast out the impurity from the holy places.

translations.ron: Şi le-a zis: "Ascultaţi-mă, leviţi! Să vă curăţiţi acum înşivă prin jertfe şi să sfinţiţi templul Domnului Dumnezeului părinţilor voştri şi să aruncaţi necurăţenia din locul sfânt afară.
translations.grk: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, ἀκούσατε οἱ Λευῖται· νῦν ἁγνίσθητε, καὶ ἁγνίσατε τὸν οἶκον Κυρίου Θεοῦ τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν, καὶ ἐκβάλετε τὴν ἀκαθαρσίαν ἐκ τῶν ἁγίων·

verses.translation: For our fathers have revolted, and done that which was evil before the Lord our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their face from the tabernacle of the Lord, and have turned their back.

translations.ron: Căci părinţii voştri au săvârşit fărădelegi şi au făcut lucruri care nu erau plăcute ochilor Domnului Dumnezeului nostru, pe Care L-au părăsit, şi-au abătut feţele de la locaşul Domnului şi s-au întors cu spatele la el;
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἀπέστησαν οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν, καὶ ἐποίησαν τὸ πονηρὸν ἐναντίον Κυρίου Θεοῦ ἡμῶν, καὶ ἐγκατέλιπαν αὐτὸν, καὶ ἀπέστρεψαν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῆς σκηνῆς Κυρίου, καὶ ἔδωκαν αὐχένα,

verses.translation: And they have shut up the doors of the temple, and put out the lamps, and have not burnt incense, and have not offered whole-burnt-offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.

translations.ron: Ba şi uşile pridvorului le-au încuiat, au stins candelele şi n-au mai tămâiat tămâie şi nici n-au mai adus arderi de tot în locaşul sfânt al Domnului lui Israel.
translations.grk: καὶ ἀπέκλεισαν τὰς θύρας τοῦ ναοῦ, καὶ ἔσβεσαν τοὺς λύχνους, καὶ θυμίαμα οὐκ ἐθυμίασαν, καὶ ὁλοκαυτώματα οὐ προσήνεγκαν ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ Θεῷ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.translation: And the Lord was very angry with Juda and Jerusalem, and made them an astonishment, and a desolation, and a hissing, as ye see with your eyes.

translations.ron: De aceea s-a coborât mânia Domnului peste Iuda şi peste Ierusalim şi i-a dat El pustiirii, batjocurii şi ruşinii, cum vedeţi şi voi singuri cu ochii voştri.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὠργίσθη ὀργῇ Κύριος ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰούδαν καὶ τὴν Ἱερουσαλὴμ, καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοὺς εἰς ἔκστασιν καὶ εἰς ἀφανισμὸν καὶ εἰς συρισμὸν ὡς ὑμεῖς ὁρᾶτε τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς ὑμῶν.

verses.translation: And, behold, your fathers have been smitten with the sword, and your sons and your daughters and your wives are in captivity in a land not their own, as it is even now.

translations.ron: Iată părinţii noştri au căzut de ascuţişul sabiei, iar fiii noştri, fetele noastre şi femeile noastre se găsesc din pricina aceasta în robie până astăzi, într-o ţară care nu este a lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἰδοὺ πεπλήγασιν οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ἐν μαχαίρᾳ, καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες ὑμῶν καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες ὑμῶν ἐν αἰχμαλωσίᾳ ἐν γῇ οὐκ αὐτῶν, ὃ καὶ νῦν ἐστιν.

verses.translation: Therefore it is now in my heart to make a covenant, a covenant with the Lord God of Israel, that he may turn away his fierce wrath from us.

translations.ron: Acum însă mâ-am pus în gând să fac legământ cu Domnul Dumnezeul lui Israel, ca să-Şi întoarcă iuţimea mâniei Sale de la noi.
translations.grk: Ἐπὶ τούτοις νῦν ἐστιν ἐπὶ καρδίας διαθέσθαι διαθήκην μου, διαθήκην Κυρίου Θεοῦ Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ἀποστρέψει τὴν ὀργὴν τοῦ θυμοῦ αὐτοῦ ἀφʼ ἡμῶν.

verses.translation: And now be not wanting to your duty, for the Lord has chosen you to stand before him to minister, and to be ministers and burners of incense to him.

translations.ron: Fiii mei, să nu pregetaţi nicidecum, căci pe voi v-a ales Domnul, ca să-I staţi înaintea feţei Lui, să-I slujiţi şi să-I fiţi slujitori şi aprinzători de tămâie".
translations.grk: Καὶ νῦν μὴ διαλίπητε, ὅτι ἐν ὑμῖν ᾑρέτικε Κύριος στῆναι ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ λειτουργεῖν, καὶ εἶναι αὐτῷ λειτουργοῦντας καὶ θυμιῶντας.

verses.translation: Then the Levites rose up, Maath the son of Amasi, and Joel the son of Azarias, of the sons of Caath: and of the sons of Merari, Kis the son of Abdi, and Azarias the son of Ilaelel: and of the sons of Gedsoni, Jodaad the son of Zemmath, and Joadam: these were the sons of Joacha.

translations.ron: Atunci s-au sculat leviţii: Mahat, fiul lui Amasia şi Ioil, fiul lui Azaria, dintre fiii lui Cahat; Chiş, fiul lui Abdi şi Azaria, fiul lui Iehaleleel, din seminţia lui Merari; Ioah, fiul lui Zima şi Eden, fiul lui Ioah, din neamul lui Gherşon;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέστησαν οἱ Λευῖται, Μαὰθ ὁ τοῦ Ἀμασὶ, καὶ Ἰωὴλ ὁ τοῦ Ἀζαρίου ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Καάθ· καὶ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Μεραρὶ, Κὶς ὁ τοῦ Ἀβδὶ, καὶ Ἀζαρίας ὁ τοῦ Ἰλαελήλ· καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Γεδσωνὶ, Ἰωδαὰδ ὁ τοῦ Ζεμμὰθ, καὶ Ἰωαδάμ· οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἰωαχά.

verses.translation: And of the sons of Elisaphan; Zambri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zacharias, and Matthanias:

translations.ron: Şimri şi Ieiel din fiii lui Eliţafan; Zaharia şi Matania, din fiii lui Asaf;
translations.grk: Καὶ τῶν υἱῶν Ἐλισαφὰν, Ζαμβρὶ, καὶ Ἰεϊήλ· καὶ τῶν υἱῶν Ἀσὰφ, Ζαχαρίας καὶ Ματθανίας·

verses.translation: and of the sons of Æman; Jeiel, and Semei: and of the sons of Idithun; Samaias, and Oziel.

translations.ron: Iehiel şi Şimei, din fiii lui Eman; Şemaia şi Uziel din fiii lui Iedutun.
translations.grk: Καὶ τῶν υἱῶν Αἰμὰν, Ἰεϊὴλ καὶ Σεμεΐ· καὶ τῶν υἱῶν Ἰδιθοὺν, Σαμαίας, καὶ Ὀζιήλ.

verses.translation: And they gathered their brethren, and they purified themselves according to the king's command by the order of the Lord, to purify the house of the Lord.

translations.ron: Aceştia au adunat pe fraţii lor şi s-au curăţit prin aduceri de jertfe; apoi s-au dus, după porunca regelui, să cureţe şi templul Domnului, după cuvintele Domnului.
translations.grk: Καὶ συνήγαγον τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτῶν, καὶ ἡγνίσθησαν κατὰ τὴν ἐντολὴν τοῦ βασιλέως διὰ προστάγματος Κυρίου, καθαρίσαι τὸν οἶκον Κυρίου.

verses.translation: And the priests entered into the house of the Lord, to purify it, and they cast out all the uncleanness that was found in the house of the Lord, even into the court of the house of the Lord: and the Levites received it to cast into the brook of Kedron without.

translations.ron: Şi au intrat preoţii înăuntrul templului Domnului pentru curăţire şi au scos afară în curtea templului tot ce au găsit necurat în locaşul sfânt al Domnului; iar leviţii au luat acestea ca să le scoată afară la pârâul Chedron.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰσῆλθον οἱ ἱερεῖς ἔσω εἰς τὸν οἶκον Κυρίου ἁγνίσαι, καὶ ἐξέβαλον πᾶσαν τὴν ἀκαθαρσίαν τὴν εὑρεθεῖσαν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Κυρίου, καὶ εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν οἴκου Κυρίου· καὶ ἐδέξαντο οἱ Λευῖται ἐκβαλεῖν εἰς τὸν χειμάῤῥουν Κέδρων ἔξω.

verses.translation: And Ezekias began on the first day, even on the new moon of the first month, to purify, and on the eighth day of the month they entered into the temple of the Lord: and they purified the house of the Lord in eight days; and on the thirteenth day of the first month they finished the work.

translations.ron: Apoi au început a face sfinţirea în ziua întâi a lunii întâi şi în ziua a opta a aceleiaşi luni au intrat în pridvorul templului Domnului. Templul Domnului l-au sfinţit opt zile; în ziua a şaisprezecea din luna întâi l-au terminat.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἤρξατο τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ πρώτῃ νουμηνίᾳ τοῦ πρώτου μηνὸς ἁγνίσαι, καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ τοῦ μηνὸς εἰσῆλθαν εἰς τὸν ναὸν Κυρίου, καὶ ἥγνισαν τὸν οἶκον Κυρίου ἐν ἡμέραις ὀκτὼ, καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρισκαιδεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου συνετέλεσαν.

verses.translation: And they went in to king Ezekias, and said, We have purified all the things in the house of the Lord, the altar of whole-burnt-offering, and its vessels, and the table of shew-bread, and its vessels;

translations.ron: După aceea s-au dus la regele Iezechia acasă şi i-au spus: "Noi am curăţit templul Domnului şi jertfelnicul cel pentru arderi de tot, cu toate vasele lui; masa pentru pâinile punerii înainte, cu toate vasele ei;
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰσῆλθαν ἔσω πρὸς Ἐξεκίαν τὸν βασιλέα, καὶ εἶπαν, ἡγνίσαμεν πάντα τὰ ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου, τὸ θυσιαστήριον τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως καὶ τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὴν τράπεζαν τῆς προθέσεως καὶ τὰ σκεύη αὐτῆς,

verses.translation: and all the vessels which king Achaz polluted in his reign, in his apostacy, we have prepared and purified: behold, they are before the altar of the Lord.

translations.ron: Şi toate vasele pe care le aruncase regele Ahaz în timpul domniei lui, în nelegiuirea sa, noi le-am pregătit şi le-am sfinţit; şi iată ele sunt înaintea jertfelnicului Domnului".
translations.grk: καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη ἃ ἐμίανεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἄχαζ ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ἀποστασίᾳ αὐτοῦ, ἡτοιμάκαμεν καὶ ἡγνίσαμεν· ἰδού ἐστιν ἐναντίον τοῦ θυσιαστήριου Κυρίου.

verses.translation: And king Ezekias rose early in the morning, and gathered the chief men of the city, and went up to the house of the Lord.

translations.ron: Atunci s-a sculat regele Iezechia foarte de dimineaţă, a adunat căpeteniile cetăţii şi s-a dus la templul Domnului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὤρθρισεν Ἐζεκίας ὁ βασιλεὺς, καὶ συνήγαγε τοὺς ἄρχοντας τῆς πόλεως, καὶ ἀνέβη εἰς οἶκον Κυρίου.

verses.translation: And he brought seven calves, seven rams, seven lambs, seven kids of goats for a sin-offering, for the kingdom, and for the holy things, and for Israel: and he told the priests the sons of Aaron to go up to the altar of the Lord.

translations.ron: Şi au adus şapte viţei, şapte berbeci, şapte miei şi şapte ţapi, ca jertfă pentru păcat: pentru regat, pentru locaşul de sfinţire şi pentru Iuda. A poruncit apoi preoţilor, fiilor lui Aaron, ca să-i aducă arderi de tot pe jertfelnicul Domnului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνήνεγκε μόσχους ἑπτὰ, κριοὺς ἑπτὰ, ἀμνοὺς ἑπτὰ, χιμάρους αἰγῶν ἑπτὰ περὶ ἁμαρτίας, περὶ τῆς βασιλείας, καὶ περὶ τῶν ἁγίων, καὶ περὶ Ἰσραήλ· καὶ εἶπε τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἀαρὼν τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν ἀναβαίνειν ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον Κυρίου.

verses.translation: And they slew the calves, and the priests received the blood, and poured it on the altar: and they slew the rams, and poured the blood upon the altar: also they slew the lambs, and poured the blood round the altar.

translations.ron: Au junghiat vitei şi au luat preoţii sângele şi au stropit cu el jertfelnicul; au junghiat berbecii şi au stropit cu sângele lor jertfelnicul; au junghiat mieii şi au stropit cu sângele lor de asemenea jertfelnicul.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔθυσαν τοὺς μόσχους, καὶ ἐδέξαντο οἱ ἱερεῖς τὸ αἷμα, καὶ προσέχεαν ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον· καὶ ἔθυσαν τοὺς κριοὺς, καὶ προσέχεαν τὸ αἷμα ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον· καὶ ἔθυσαν τοὺς ἀμνοὺς, καὶ περιέχεον τὸ αἷμα τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ.

verses.translation: And they brought the goats for a sin-offering before the king and the congregation; and laid their hands upon them.

translations.ron: Apoi au adus ţapii cei pentru păcat înaintea regelui şi a adunării; aceştia şi-au pus mâinile peste ei.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσήγαγον τοὺς χιμάρους τοὺς περὶ ἁμαρτίας ἐναντίον τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τῆς ἐκκλησίας, καὶ ἐπέθηκαν τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν ἐπʼ αὐτούς.

verses.translation: And the priests slew them, and offered their blood as a propitiation on the altar; and they made atonement for all Israel: for the king said, The whole-burnt-offering, and the sin-offerings are for all Israel.

translations.ron: Şi i-au junghiat preoţii şi au curăţit cu sângele lor jertfelnicul pentru ştergerea păcatelor întregului Israel, căci regele poruncise să se aducă arderi de tot şi jertfă pentru păcat, pentru sine şi pentru tot Israelul.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔθυσαν αὐτοὺς οἱ ἱερεῖς, καὶ ἐξιλάσαντο τὸ αἷμα αὐτῶν πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον, καὶ ἐξιλάσαντο περὶ παντὸς Ἰσραὴλ, ὅτι εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς, περὶ παντὸς Ἰσραὴλ ἡ ὁλοκαύτωσις, καὶ τὰ περὶ ἁμαρτίας.

verses.translation: And he stationed the Levites in the house of the Lord with cymbals, and lutes, and harps, according to the commandment of king David, and of Gad the king's seer, and Nathan the prophet: for by the commandment of the Lord the order was in the hand of the prophets.

translations.ron: Apoi a aşezat în templul Domnului leviţi cu chimvale, cu harpe şi cu chitare, după rânduiala lui David şi a lui Gad, văzătorul regelui, şi a lui Natan proorocul, fiindcă de către Domnul se aşezase această rânduială prin proorocii Lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔστησε τοὺς Λευίτας ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου ἐν κυμβάλοις, καὶ ἐν νάβλαις, καὶ ἐν κινύραις κατὰ τὴν ἐντολὴν Δαυὶδ τοῦ βασιλέως, καὶ Γὰδ τοῦ ὁρῶντος τῷ βασιλεῖ, καὶ Νάθαν τοῦ προφήτου, ὅτι διὰ ἐντολῆς Κυρίου τὸ πρόσταγμα ἐν χειρὶ τῶν προφητῶν.

verses.translation: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.

translations.ron: Şi stăteau leviţii cu instrumentele de cântare ale lui David şi preoţii cu trâmbiţele.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔστησαν οἱ Λευῖται ἐν ὀργάνοις Δαυὶδ, καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς ταῖς σάλπιγξι.

verses.translation: And Ezekias told them to offer up the whole-burnt-offering on the altar: and when they began to offer the whole-burnt-offering, they began to sing to the Lord, and the trumpets accompanied the instruments of David king of Israel.

translations.ron: Şi a poruncit Iezechia să se aducă arderi de tot pe jertfelnic. Şi în timpul când a început arderea de tot, a început şi cântarea pentru Domnul cu trâmbiţele şi cu instrumentele de cântare ale lui David, regele lui Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν Ἐζεκίας ἀνένεγκαι τὴν ὁλοκαύτωσιν ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον· καὶ ἐν τῷ ἄρξασθαι ἀναφέρειν τὴν ὁλοκαύτωσιν, ἤρξαντο ᾄδειν Κυρίῳ, καὶ σάλπιγγες πρὸς τὰ ὄργανα Δαυὶδ βασιλέως Ἰσραήλ.

verses.translation: And all the congregation worshipped, and the psalm-singers were singing, and the trumpets sounding, until the whole-burnt-sacrifice had been completely offered.

translations.ron: Şi toată adunarea a făcut rugăciuni, iar cântăreţii au cântat din fluiere, până s-a terminat arderea de tot.
translations.grk: Καὶ πᾶσα ἡ ἐκκλησία προσεκύνει, καὶ οἱ ψαλτῳδοὶ ᾄδοντες, καὶ σάλπιγγες σαλπίζουσαι ἕως οὗ συνετελέσθη ἡ ὁλοκαύτωσις.

verses.translation: And when they had done offering it, the king and all that were present bowed, and worshipped.

translations.ron: Iar după terminarea arderii de tot, regele şi toţi care se aflau cu el s-au plecat şi s-au închinat.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὡς συνετέλεσαν ἀναφέροντες, ἔκαμψεν ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ πάντες οἱ εὑρεθέντες, καὶ προσεκύνησαν.

verses.translation: And king Ezekias and the princes told the Levites to sing hymns to the Lord in the words of David, and of Asaph the prophet: and they sang hymns with gladness, and fell down and worshipped.

translations.ron: Iezechia regele şi căpeteniile au zis către leviţi, să slăvească pe Domnul cu cuvintele lui David şi ale lui Asaf văzătorul, şi ei L-au slăvit cu mare bucurie şi s-au plecat la pământ şi s-au închinat.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν Ἐζεκίας ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες τοῖς Λευίταις, ὑμνεῖν τὸν Κύριον ἐν λόγοις Δαυὶδ καὶ Ἀσὰφ τοῦ προφήτου· καὶ ὕμνουν ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ, καὶ ἔπεσον καὶ προσεκύνησαν.

verses.translation: Then Ezekias answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves to the Lord, bring near and offer sacrifices of praise in the house of the Lord. And the congregation brought sacrifices and thank-offerings into the house of the Lord; and every one who was ready in his heart brought whole-burnt-offerings.

translations.ron: Apoi a început Iezechia a grăi şi a zis: "Acum v-aţi sfinţit pe voi Domnului; apropiaţi-vă şi aduceţi jertfe şi prinoase de mulţumire în templul Domnului". Şi a adus toată adunarea jertfe şi prinoase de laudă şi de împăcare, şi cel pe care-l lăsa inima, arderi de tot.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Ἐζεκίας, καὶ εἶπε, νῦν ἐπληρώσατε τὰς χεῖρας ὑμῶν Κυρίῳ, προσαγάγετε καὶ φέρετε θυσίας αἰνέσεως εἰς οἶκον Κυρίου· καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν ἡ ἐκκλησία θυσίας καὶ αἰνέσεις εἰς οἶκον Κυρίου, καὶ πᾶς πρόθυμος τῇ καρδίᾳ ὁλοκαυτώσεις.

verses.translation: And the number of the whole-burnt-offerings which the congregation brought, was seventy calves, a hundred rams, two hundred lambs: all these were for a whole-burnt-offering to the Lord.

translations.ron: Numărul vitelor pentru arderile de tot, aduse de cei ce se adunaseră a fost: şaptezeci de boi, o sută de berbeci, două sute de miei. Toate acestea au fost jertfite ca arderi de tot Domnului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως ἧς ἀνήνεγκεν ἡ ἐκκλησία, μόσχοι ἑβδομήκοντα, κριοὶ ἑκατὸν, ἀμνοὶ διακόσιοι· εἰς ὁλοκαύτωσιν Κυρίῳ πάντα ταῦτα.

verses.translation: And the consecrated calves were six hundred, and the sheep three thousand.

translations.ron: Pentru celelalte jertfe sfinte au fost şase sute de vite mari şi trei mii de vite mărunte.
translations.grk: Καὶ οἱ ἠγιασμένοι μόσχοι ἑξακόσιοι, πρόβατα τρισχίλια.

verses.translation: But the priests were few, and could not flay the whole-burnt-offering, so their brethren the Levites helped them, until the work was finished, and until the priests had purified themselves: for the Levites more zealously purified themselves than the priests.

translations.ron: Însă preoţii au fost puţini şi nu puteau să jupoaie toate arderile de tot; de aceea le-au ajutat şi leviţii, fraţii lor, până ce au terminat lucrul şi până ce s-au sfinţit preoţii; căci leviţii au fost mai silitori la sfinţire decât preoţii.
translations.grk: Ἀλλʼ ἢ οἱ ἱερεῖς ἦσαν ὀλίγοι, καὶ οὐκ ἠδύναντο ἐκδεῖραι τὴν ὁλοκαύτωσιν, καὶ ἀντελάβοντο αὐτῶν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν οἱ Λευῖται ἕως οὗ συνετελέσθη τὸ ἔργον, καὶ ἕως οὗ ἡγνίσθησαν οἱ ἱερεῖς· ὅτι οἱ Λευῖται προθύμως ἥγνισαν παρὰ τοὺς ἱερεῖς.

verses.translation: And the whole-burnt-offering was abundant, with the fat of the complete peace-offering, and the drink-offerings of the whole-burnt-sacrifice. So the service was established in the house of the Lord.

translations.ron: Afară de aceasta a mai fost o mulţime de arderi de tot cu grăsimi de jertfe de împăcare şi cu turnări de vin la arderi de tot. Aşa s-a aşezat la loc slujba în templul Domnului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἡ ὁλοκαύτωσις πολλὴ ἐν τοῖς στέασι τῆς τελειώσεως τοῦ σωτηρίου καὶ τῶν σπονδῶν τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως· καὶ κατωρθώθη τὸ ἔργον ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου.

verses.translation: And Ezekias and all the people rejoiced, because God had prepared the people: for the thing was done suddenly.

translations.ron: Şi s-a bucurat Iezechia dimpreună cu tot poporul, că Dumnezeu a potrivit aşa pe popor, încât s-a făcut acest lucru, cum nici nu se aşteptase.
translations.grk: Καὶ ηὐφράνθη Ἐζεκίας καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς, διὰ τὸ ἡτοιμακέναι τὸν Θεὸν τῷ λαῷ, ὅτι ἐξάπινα ἐγένετο ὁ λόγος.
